name: eshttp
description: ES3 ExtendScript HTTP client for Adobe hosts (eshttp.dll native accelerator + Socket fallback). TypeScript source (src/*.ts) bundled by esbuild into dist/eshttp.jsx (ES3 IIFE, #include/$.evalFile safe) + dist/eshttp-core.esm.mjs (Node harnesses). This package.json stays `type: commonjs` because the QA harness (test/harness.js) is a CommonJS .js file; the ESM core bundle is a .mjs file and imports fine from .mjs harnesses or via dynamic import() from CommonJS.

scripts.estc:check: node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/eshttp.jsx --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/eshttp-native-accel.jsx --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/eshttp-native-accel-x86.jsx --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/eshttp.accel-x64.jsx --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/eshttp.accel-x86.jsx --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check src/eshttp.jsxinc --no-target
scripts.estc:live-parse: node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/eshttp.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/eshttp-native-accel.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/eshttp-native-accel-x86.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/eshttp.accel-x64.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/eshttp.accel-x86.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check src/eshttp.jsxinc --no-target --live --launch
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && node eshttp-build.mjs --include-compat && node test/harness.js --all && npm run test:parity && npm run test:parity:esb64 && npm run test:never-throw && npm run test:audit-dist
scripts.release:gate: npm run verify && npm run estc:check && npm run estc:live-parse && npm run live:verify
